The company explicitly reports customer-base growth. Doubling the count above a spending threshold alone would not prove new customers, but the surrounding statement also describes customer growth.

reviews.rationale: The packet establishes the capacity condition and supports continued customer additions. Contemporary company uptime figures place the main services near or below 99%, matching the ordinary reading of struggling to stay above that threshold. These are partly company disclosures. The moral judgment about greed is not graded.
